title: Nuclear Power Plants
referenceAnswerText:
The following graph gives information about nuclear power plants in operation in Europe.
As we can see from the map, the largest nuclear electricity generation is in France, which is 59.
Following that the second largest one is found in Russia, and it is 30.
In contrast, the Netherlands has the smallest number, just 1.
Apart from that, Spain has 7, Germany has 8 and the United Kingdom has 15.
To sum up, the graph tells about how nuclear electricity generation is distributed in Europe.

title: World Water
referenceAnswerText:
The following graph gives information about the world's water distribution.
It can be seen that 97.5% of the world's water is salt water and only 2.5% is freshwater.
In the freshwater sector, glaciers and permanent snow occupy the largest proportion at 68.7%.
And, groundwater occupies 30.06% of the fresh water.
Ground ice and permafrost takes up 0.86% of fresh water and other resources, 1.22%.
In the other sector, lakes occupy the majority of the percentage, about 0.26%.
In conclusion, this image gives information about the world's water distribution.

title: Adult Literacy
referenceAnswerText:
The following graph gives information about adult literacy by region from 2000-2004.
As we can see the largest amount is in Latin America and the Caribbean, 89% in females and 91% in males.
And Asia has the second highest rate, 73% in females and 86% in males.
However, we can see the smallest amounts in sub-Saharan Africa, which are 53% in females and 70% in males.
In conclusion, males have a larger adult literacy rate than females in all the regions.

title: Sport Participants
referenceAnswerText:
The bar chart shows the percentages of male and female participants in four sports.
Football has the highest percentage of male participants, at 70%, but only 30% for females.
The figures for cricket are 60% and 40%, while basketball records 55% and 45%.
In tennis, the female proportion was higher, about 60%, compared with 40% for males.
Overall, football shows the largest gender difference.
To sum up, males participate more in football, cricket and basketball, while females participated more in tennis.
